result.title: Sequential Testing on Complex and High Dimensional Data Streams Leveraging Unsupervised Model Errors
result.summary: We propose two general, distribution-free test statistics for binary Sequential Hypothesis Testing (SHT) and Sequential Change Point Detection (SCPD) respectively, in streaming environments where the data (e.g., network traffic metadata) are too complicated for the exact probabilistic modeling required by conventional likelihood ratio-driven tests. Our framework also addresses the challenge of information asymmetry, where data is available only from the null/pre-change regime and not from the alternative/post-change one such as zero-day attacks or emerging disease related regimes. The proposed statistics monitor the errors of a predictive or reconstructive machine learning model trained solely on null/pre-change data, relying on imperfect generalization (the model's performance will degrade when deployed on data from the alternative/post-change class). Under mild assumptions on the model's errors, we establish rigorous analytical guarantees: strict non-asymptotic error control for SHT, and explicit bounds on the Average Run Length (ARL) and the Expected Detection Delay (EDD) for SCPD. Extensive evaluations in target tracking, chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world network security datasets, demonstrate that our framework consistently satisfies prescribed constraints where existing algorithms succumb to inflated missed detections and/or false alarms. Finally, because our methods operate on scalar errors without requiring online retraining or kernel evaluations, they are highly scalable.

AI.brief_summary: 提出两种无分布的二值序贯检验统计量，分别用于流式数据上的序贯假设检验与变点检测，仅监控在零假设数据上训练的无监督预测/重建模型的误差，并给出非渐近错误控制以及 ARL、EDD 的显式界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「累积模型误差作为证据、在预设错误率约束下决定是否停止」的思路，可能与 LVR 中何时停止思考或继续获取视觉证据的停止准则与风险控制可供核查地相关。
